description: Open a data-subject request as a case (Art. 15-20 GDPR): information, correction, erasure, restriction or portability. The statutory deadline is one month; it is SET on creation rather than computed on read, so an extension stays visible. Creates a todo as the reminder — a deadline nobody sees is not a deadline.

due_at.description: ISO date. Defaults to one month from today.

kind.description: Type of request: information, correction, erasure, restriction or portability

measures.description: What is planned or has been done.

name: create_dsr_request
